title: Text stats with bufio.Scanner
hints: `sc := bufio.NewScanner(r)` then `for sc.Scan() { ... }`. The loop ends at EOF **or** on an error; `sc.Err()` tells you which (nil means a clean end).
Lines are the default split. For words call `sc.Split(bufio.ScanWords)` before the first `Scan`. A helper `count(r io.Reader, split bufio.SplitFunc) (int, error)` can serve both counters.

For `Longest`, keep `best` and `bestLen := -1`; for each `line := sc.Text()`, `if n := utf8.RuneCountInString(line); n > bestLen { best, bestLen = line, n }` (strict `>` keeps the first on ties). Finish with `return best, sc.Err()`.
